item.title: Self-Hosted IoT Device Management: Kaa IoT vs DeviceHive vs Mainflux
item.description: Managing hundreds or thousands of IoT devices — sensors, actuators, gateways — requires more than simple MQTT brokers. You need device provisioning, firmware updates, telemetry routing, rule engines, and dashboards. While commercial IoT cloud platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub) offer these capabilities, self-hosted alternatives give you full control over your device data and eliminate recurring cloud costs.
